import argparse

import os

)

    "clean_s9": 306,
    "clean_s10": 307,
    "contam_15": 42,
    "contam_50": 42,
}


def find_model_path():
    patterns = [

    parser.add_argument("--condition", required=True, choices=list(SEED_MAP.keys()))
